scripts.build: npm run build -w @mc/protocol && npm run build -w @mc/control-plane && npm run build -w @mc/dashboard
scripts.build:control: npm run build -w @mc/protocol && npm run build -w @mc/control-plane
scripts.build:mods: npm run build:forge && npm run build:neoforge
scripts.release:portable: npm run build:portable && npm run scan:portable
scripts.release:single-exe: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-single-exe.ps1 -BuildPortable && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/scan-single-exe.ps1
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mc/protocol && concurrently -k -n server,ui -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @mc/control-plane" "npm run dev -w @mc/dashboard"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @mc/control-plane
scripts.start:control: npm run build:control && npm run start -w @mc/control-plane
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/live-preflight.test.mjs scripts/live-action-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-ranch-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-food-delivery-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-food-survival-restart-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-storage-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-storage-restart-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-deep-mining-smoke.test.mjs scripts/final-smart-tchat-acceptance.test.mjs scripts/final-stable-tchat-acceptance.test.mjs scripts/live-build-palette-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-build-material-chain-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-build-resume-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-natural-tree-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-no-cheat-expedition-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-player-life-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-follow-resilience-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-craft-chain-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-resource-priority-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-explicit-crafting-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-bed-sleep-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-dragon-action-smoke.test.mjs scripts/live-dragon-care-smoke.test.mjs scripts/send-minecraft-chat-background.test.mjs scripts/portable-release-gate.test.mjs && npm run test:background-automation
scripts.test:background-automation: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/stop-minecraft-for-update.test.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/launch-hmcl-background.test.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/enter-hmcl-test-world.test.ps1
